svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Campaigns
svg.desc: Four panels on running campaigns. a, the built-in model families with their number of models, from 22 for MACE to one each for ANI-1xnr, MACE-FIELD, and NEP89, plus any ASE calculator or a custom adapter. b, NEB keeps the cell fixed and reports an energy barrier, SSNEB relaxes the cell of every image and reports an enthalpy barrier. The SSNEB barrier of a model system rises from 0.062 eV at 0 GPa to 0.095 eV at 0.8 GPa. c, a run stopped and restored at step 150 against one that never stopped. The exact restart follows the same cell volume with zero position difference, and a restart from atoms, momenta, and cell drifts away by 0.4 Å. d, eight trajectories on two four-GPU nodes over two jobs. Refinement pauses only its own trajectory, an error stops only its own trajectory, and the second job resumes the rest.
